guitar.notes: Mark Farner is well known for his Messenger guitar (aluminum-neck) among other models during the band's heyday.

tone.target: dry mid-gain classic rock crunch with slight fuzz grit
tone.profile: dry mid-gain classic rock crunch with slight fuzz grit
tone.summary: The chain uses a slight dirt pedal (OD 9) for initial grit, followed by the UK 45/UK Vintage 4x12 combination to deliver classic Marshall-style mid-forward punch and sustain.

rig.name: Grand Funk Railroad - I'm Your Captain (Closer to Home) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide the required mid-forward crunch and slight fuzz edge.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used to simulate a light dirt pedal/boost, fulfilling the 'slight fuzz grit' requirement without excessive distortion.

blocks.purpose: Add controlled fuzz grit and strong attack as requested.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is chosen over Fuzz/Muff-style to keep the dirt focused on mid-range punch rather than pure psychedelic wash, matching the 'classic rock' feel.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the Marshall/Plexi style amp for classic rock tone and mid-forward punch.
Provide the classic Marshall-style cabinet sound.
Fine-tune the mid-forward crunch and punchiness.
Kept inactive to avoid heavy modulation and maintain a dry punchy sound.
blocks.gap: None (Used as an optional slot filler, but kept off).

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without sounding like 'lush reverb', maintaining punchiness.
blocks.gap: The delay is used sparingly to add dimension, fulfilling the need for sustain without excessive ambience.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the raw, aggressive punch of classic rock without losing the Marshall character.

proposals.reason: Enhance mid-range aggression and vintage grit for a punchier classic rock sound.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased bite and definition in the mids.
